steps.title: Complete the Tombs of Amascut until …
steps.text: Complete the Tombs of Amascut until you receive an Osmumten's fang

steps.title: In the setups, you can store …
steps.text: In the setups, you can store the pickaxe in the raid and utilize the lasting poison resistance from Ambrosia in a previous raid. They are just there to remind you to bring them the first time. — Depending on your boss order, you might be able to drop the ranging potion or super combat potion.
